title: Verificar en navegador la física de empuje del Scroll v17
mission: Open the exact v17 Scroll/Pinterest surface in a representative browser and verify its real scroll geometry at desktop and narrow viewport without modifying source bytes or promoting Human Acceptance/champion authority.
definition_of_done: Record the exact main and served source identity used for the run before interacting.
Verify there is one left vertical rail and visible chapter divider lines, with no extra framing lines introduced by the tested surface.
For each transition, verify the incoming chapter number begins exactly at its chapter divider and moves with the chapter before sticky engagement.

Verify the current number remains pinned at the viewport-top rail position until the incoming chapter boundary reaches it; reject early movement, gaps, overlap/intersection, disappearance, or visible jitter.
Verify the incoming divider/number physically displaces the prior number and becomes the pinned number with no dead zone.
Verify the number/divider spatial relationship remains consistent through transitions and the final chapter number remains pinned when no successor exists.
Repeat the checks at a narrow/mobile viewport and record any clipping, overlap, horizontal overflow, vibration or responsive divergence.
Capture durable pass/fail evidence for every invariant; do not infer Human Acceptance from a runtime pass.
Do not modify Current, Served, Catalog, champion, Human Accepted, or the v17 source in this verification job.
